title: Unique Crisp Argentinian Chicken Liver Skillet
description: A mustardy and cozy Argentinian dish featuring chicken liver, this skillet is perfect for a cold evening, and its ingredients are chosen to be anti-inflammatory friendly. The combination of chicken liver, garlic, and herbs creates a delicious and savory flavor profile.

ingredients.name: chicken liver
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken liver to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken liver from the skillet and set aside.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the dijon mustard and cook for 1 minute, until heated through.
Add the chopped parsley and oregano to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Return the chicken liver to the skillet and stir to combine with the garlic and herb mixture.
Season with salt, black pepper, and turmeric, and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the liver is cooked through.
Serve the chicken liver skillet hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
